# BoldFlow Labs
> 24/7 TRAI-Compliant Multilingual AI Phone Assistants & Voice Agents for Indian Businesses

BoldFlow Labs (https://www.boldflowlabs.com) is an AI telephony automation agency based in Kerala, India, specializing in low-latency (<180ms) multilingual conversational AI voice receptionists and outbound callback systems. We eliminate missed revenue leaks for Indian high-growth enterprises by responding to inquiries in seconds in native Indian languages.

## Core Services & Solutions

### 1. 24/7 AI Phone Receptionists
- Answers inbound calls in under 10 seconds 24/7/365.
- Native fluency in Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Hinglish, and Indian English.
- Pre-qualifies caller intent, collects key requirements, answers FAQs, and books meetings directly into calendars or CRMs.

### 2. Instant Outbound Lead Callbacks (Speed-to-Lead)
- Triggers automated phone callbacks within 60 seconds of a portal lead submission (99acres, MagicBricks, Meta Ads, Google Ads, website forms).
- Delivers up to 7x higher lead conversion compared to delayed manual callbacks.

### 3. E-Commerce COD Confirmation & RTO Reduction
- Calls shoppers within minutes of Cash-on-Delivery (COD) checkout to confirm shipping address and intent to pay.
- Reduces Return-to-Origin (RTO) courier losses by up to 35% for Indian D2C brands.

### 4. Policy Renewal & Lapse Prevention Voice Agents
- Conducts automated reminder calls to policyholders 30 days and 7 days prior to policy lapse.
- Books advisor callbacks for policy modifications, protecting annual renewal commissions.

## Indian Telephony & Regulatory Compliance
- Telephony Infrastructure: Voice Link, Vobiz, Exotel, and Plivo SIP trunks with native +91 virtual numbers.
- Regulatory Adherence: Fully compliant with Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) directives and National Do Not Call (NDNC/DND) registry filtering.
- Latency Benchmark: Sub-180ms audio roundtrip with streaming speech synthesis for natural conversational interruption and human pacing.

## Software & CRM Integrations
- CRMs: LeadSquared, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Calendar, Excel / Google Sheets.
- Messaging: WhatsApp Business API (instant dispatch of brochures, address pins, booking confirmations).
- E-Commerce: Shopify, WooCommerce, Shiprocket, ClickPost.

## Transparent Pricing Tiers

1. Starter Plan — ₹9,999 / month
   - 1,000 call minutes included (~33 mins/day)
   - Inbound call reception
   - 1 regional Indian language or English
   - Standard CRM webhook sync
   - 99.5% uptime SLA

2. Growth Plan — ₹19,999 / month (Most Popular)
   - 3,000 call minutes included (~100 mins/day)
   - Inbound reception + outbound lead callbacks
   - English + 1 regional Indian language
   - Instant WhatsApp confirmation automation
   - LeadSquared / Zoho 2-way CRM sync
   - Priority SLA support

3. Enterprise Plan — Custom Pricing
   - High-volume scalable minutes
   - All 8+ supported regional Indian languages
   - Custom SIP trunking & dedicated telephony carrier routes
   - Custom on-premise or ERP integrations
   - Dedicated voice solutions architect
